approved_definition_context: Fin n has exactly the natural-number indices with value less than n. Every indicated finite sum runs over the entire finite carrier. The coercion from natural numbers to real numbers has its usual meaning.

Matrix m n real is a finite real array. Matrix.vecMulVec w v has entry w_i v_j. Matrix.one is the diagonal identity. Scalars multiply each entry. Matrix.kronecker A B has paired-index entry A_(i,j) B_(k,l), with the first index of each pair belonging to A.

Matrix.PosSemidef A requires Hermitian symmetry and nonnegative real quadratic forms for every vector, equivalently positive-semidefinite order. Matrix subtraction and scalar multiplication are ordinary real matrix operations.
